rows.statement: CR-1457 does not print the honeycomb face-wrinkling half-wavelength. Zeta in the solid-or-foam section is not that length, and it is not the honeycomb formula.
Whether the wrinkle is long beside R 30 m is unchecked. The cell-to-R comparison is not a calculated half-wavelength.
kb, the one-half factor, the 200 F reference, the 1.002 factor and the 25 psi allowable are code constants. They are absent from CR-1457, DOI 10.2514/3.5568 and DOI 10.2514/3.1932.
The face temperatures are a log interpolation of a transferred R 30 table, not a measurement on this sandwich.
No face density makes the thermal interface bind before wrinkling on the design-point gauges. Face density does not enter either margin.
